Teach him these 6 things before the world does. 🌧️

Nathan is six. Every lesson you give him is a stone he stands on:
1️⃣ Keep your word, even when nobody's watching. 🐶
2️⃣ Learn to hear "no" and be disappointed without falling apart.
3️⃣ Own your mistakes. His ball breaks a window… "How do I make it right?" 🪟
4️⃣ Respect everyone. Do something for the kid nobody picks. 🤝
5️⃣ Do hard things. Don't quit. 🏊
6️⃣ Know your worth, and stay humble. Confidence says "I can learn." Pride says "I'm the best."

Then the storms come. His friends want him to lie for them. He gets cut from the team, heartbroken. A hard night in the car. 🌧️

Jesus said the wise man built his house on the rock. "And the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house, but it did not fall." Matthew 7:25 (ESV)

The stones held, but the Rock held everything. 🙏 Jesus did the hardest part, and He keeps every promise.

You lay the stones. Jesus is the Rock. ❤️
